Explanation:  
The question asks for the population of Juneau, Alaska (the capital of the US state admitted in January 1959) according to "the last census of the 20th century." The "Ground Truth Answer" is 26,751. The "Predicted Answer" states the population as approximately 30,700 (30,711), specifically giving the 2000 Census number. The last census of the 20th century was the 1990 Census (the 2000 Census is considered the first census of the 21st century, as censuses are conducted after each decade ends). Therefore, the "Predicted Answer" does not match the ground truth in terms of content: it used the 2000 Census figure instead of the 1990 Census figure, which was 26,751.

Decision: FALSE
